definitions.short: to commit adultery ; figuratively, to apostatize
definitions.usage: adulterer(-ess), commit(-ing) adultery, woman that breaketh wedlock.
definitions.full: H5003. naaph [ נאַף ] verb commit adultery (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic נְאַף (rare)): — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יִנְאַף Lev 20:10 (twice in verse); 3masculine plural וַיִּנְאָ֑פוּ Jer 5:7 3 t. Imperfect; Infinitive absolute נָאוֺף 23:14 ; נָאֹף Hosea 4:2 ; Jer 7:9 ; Participle נֹאֵף Prov 6:32 ; Job 24:15 ; feminine singular נֹאָ֑פֶת Lev 20:10 ; feminine plural נֹאֲפוֺת Ezek 16:38 2 t.; — 1 literally commit adultery: a. usually of man , always with wife of another; with accusative woman, Lev 20:10 (twice in verse) (H), Prov 6:32 ; elsewhere absolute Exod 20:14 = Deut 5:17 (Ten Words), Jer 5:7 ; 7:9 ; 23:14 ; Hosea 4:2 ; participle masculine Lev 20:10 (H), Job 24:15 . b. of women , only participle Lev 20:10 (H), Ezek 16:38 ; 23:45 (twice in verse). 2 figurative of idolatrous worship , העץ ואת האבן את Jer 3:9 . Piel Perfect 3feminine singular נִאֲפָה Jer 3:8 ; 3 masculine plural נִאֵ֑פוּ Ezek 23:37 (twice in verse); Imperfect 3masculine plural יְנַאֲפוּ Jer 29:23 ; 3 feminine plural תְּנָאַפְנָה Hosea 4:13-14 , Participle מְנָאֵף Isa 57:3 ; plural מְנָאֲפִים Jer 9:1 4 t.; feminine מְנָאָ֑פֶת Prov 30:20 2 t.; — 1 literally commit adultery: a. of man , with accusative woman, Jer 29:23 ; absolute Ezek 23:37 ; pt plural Jer 9:2 ; 23:10 ; Hosea 7:4 ; Mal 3:5 ; Psa 50:18 . b. of woman , absolute Hosea 4:13-14 , participle 3:1 ; Prov 30:20 ; plural Ezek 16:32 . 2 figurative of idolatrous worship , אֶתגִּֿלּוּלֵיהֶם Ezek 23:37 ; absolute Jer 3:8 , מְנָאֵף זֶאֶרַע Isa 57:3 .

“You shall not commit adultery.
The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight,
When you saw a thief, you consented with him,
He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding.
“So is the way of an adulterous woman:
“But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress,

I saw when, for this very cause, that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet treacherous Judah, her sister, had no fear; but she also went and played the prostitute.
Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood.

“How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.
Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,
Oh that my head were waters,
For the land is full of adulterers;
In the prophets of Jerusalem I have also seen a horrible thing:

because they have done foolish things in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and have spoken words in my name falsely, which I didn’t command them. I am he who knows, and am witness,” says Yahweh.
“ ‘ “A wife who commits adultery! Who takes strangers instead of her husband!
I will judge you, as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.

For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass through the fire to them to be devoured.

Yahweh said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as Yahweh loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”
There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery;
They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains,
I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute,
They are all adulterers.

I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says Yahweh of Armies.
